description: This PHP file defines the ReviewListAPI class, which handles API requests related to listing performance reviews within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to retrieve a list of reviews with filtering, sorting, and pagination functionality, along with associated validation rules. The class integrates traits and models for handling authentication, performance review data, and request validation.
